mcp_tools.name: sourced_podcast_episode_production
mcp_tools.title: Sourced podcast episode production
mcp_tools.description: Submit a podcast episode production record (declared scoping and outline sections, sources, quote/statistic claim rows with source references, script, narration and assembly, show-notes source list, rights, guest-release and publishing declarations, red lines) and return a deterministic EPISODE_PRODUCTION_SOUND / EPISODE_PRODUCTION_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including computed claim-to-source traceability and show-notes source-list matching, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record only; produces no audio, writes no script, publishes nothing.

inputSchema.description: The sourced podcast episode production manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).
